_about: Dimension-level evaluations of genuine experimental responses (data/responses.json). The "Download JSON record" button on score.html produces one record in this format; paste it into `evaluations`, then run `python build.py`. The build refuses records that refer to an unknown response, scores outside 0–4, or a total that does not equal the dimension scores. Illustrative Appendix A judgments are read from the rubric document and must not be added here.

rubric.document: Nordland: Evaluator Interpretations and Assessment Criteria
